unitTitle: Present Perfect - Past Simple - Ever/Never - Just - Yet/Already - For/Since

sections.title: Nazariya — Past Simple, ever/never, just, yet/already, for/since, gone/been
sections.titleUz: Nazariya — Past Simple, ever/never, just, yet/already, for/since, gone/been

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use the PAST SIMPLE for an action which
    happened at a STATED TIME in the past.'
      They TRAVELLED to France LAST SUMMER.
      (When? Last summer. The time IS
       MENTIONED.)

 • 'Time adverbs used with the past simple:
    YESTERDAY, TWO/THREE etc DAYS/MONTHS etc
    AGO, LAST MONDAY/WEEK/MONTH, etc.'


⚠ PRESENT PERFECT BILAN FARQI:

  PRESENT PERFECT — vaqt AYTILMAGAN
     'He HAS WASHED the car.'
     (qachonligi noma'lum)

  PAST SIMPLE — vaqt AYTILGAN
     'They TRAVELLED to France LAST SUMMER.'
     (qachon? — o'tgan yozda)

  Bu — butun Unit 15 ning o'zagi.


PAST SIMPLE VAQT RAVIShLARI:
  yesterday          (kecha)
  two days ago       (ikki kun oldin)
  three months ago   (uch oy oldin)
  last Monday        (o'tgan dushanba)
  last week          (o'tgan hafta)
  last month         (o'tgan oy)
  last summer        (o'tgan yozda)
  in 2010            (2010-yilda)
  when I was a child (bolaligimda)


⚠ ENG KO'P XATO:
  'I have seen him YESTERDAY.'      ✗
  'I SAW him yesterday.'            ✓

  'They have travelled LAST SUMMER.' ✗
  'They TRAVELLED last summer.'      ✓


DIQQAT — 'AGO' va 'FOR':
  'two days AGO'  → PAST SIMPLE
     'I arrived two days ago.'
  'FOR two days'  → PRESENT PERFECT
     'I've been here for two days.'

  Ikkalasi ham 'ikki kun', lekin zamonlari
  BOSHQA.


DIQQAT — 'TRAVELLED':
  Britancha: travelLED (IKKI 'L')
  Amerikacha: traveLED (bitta 'L')
  Enterprise — britancha kitob.

points.en: We use the past simple for an action which happened at a stated time in the past.  —  They travelled to France last summer. (When? Last summer. The time is mentioned.)
points.uz: Past Simple ni o'tmishda VAQTI AYTILGAN holda sodir bo'lgan harakat uchun ishlatamiz. — Ular o'tgan yozda Fransiyaga sayohat qilishdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'STATED TIME' = aytilgan vaqt.
Present Perfect esa 'UNSTATED TIME'
(64-bet).

points.en: Time adverbs used with the past simple: yesterday, two/three etc days/months etc ago, last Monday/week/month, etc.
points.uz: Past Simple bilan ishlatiladigan vaqt ravishlari: yesterday, two/three kun/oy oldin, last Monday/week/month va h.k.
points.noteUz:
'AGO' — DOIM Past Simple bilan.
'FOR' — Present Perfect bilan (adashtirmang!).

exercises.explanationUz:
EVER / NEVER — KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use EVER in questions and statements.'
      Have you EVER visited Prague?
      Madrid is the best city I've EVER
      visited.

 • 'We use NEVER in statements.'
      I've NEVER visited America.
      (= I HAVEN'T visited America.)


'EVER' IKKI HOLATDA:
  1) SAVOLDA — 'hech qachon ...ganmisiz?'
        'Have you EVER visited Prague?'
  2) USTUN DARAJA bilan — 'ko'rgan eng ...'
        'Madrid is the BEST city I've EVER
         visited.'


'NEVER' — O'ZI INKOR:
     'I've NEVER visited America.'   ✓
     'I haven't NEVER visited.'      ✗ XATO!

  Kitob ikki xil aytish mumkinligini
  ko'rsatadi:
     'I've NEVER visited America.'
     'I HAVEN'T visited America.'
  Ma'nosi bir xil, lekin 'never' KUCHLIROQ.


O'RNI: 'have' va V3 ORASIDA
     'Have you EVER visited ...?'
     'I've NEVER visited ...'


─────────────────────────────────────

JUST — KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use JUST in statements to show that an
    action finished only A FEW MINUTES
    EARLIER.'
      A: Have you finished your homework?
      B: Yes, I've JUST finished it.


'JUST' = hozirgina, endigina
  Harakat bir necha DAQIQA oldin tugagan.

O'RNI: 'have' va V3 ORASIDA
     'I've JUST finished it.'  ✓
     'I've finished it JUST.'  ✗


DIQQAT — 'JUST' NING BOShQA MA'NOSI:
  'just' — faqat, shunchaki:
     'It's JUST a joke.' (shunchaki hazil)
  Present Perfect bilan esa 'hozirgina'.

points.en: We use ever in questions and statements.  —  Have you ever visited Prague? Madrid is the best city I've ever visited.
points.uz: EVER ni savol va darak gaplarda ishlatamiz. — Pragaga borganmisiz? Madrid — men borgan eng yaxshi shahar.
points.noteUz:
IKKI HOLAT: savolda; ustun daraja bilan.
O'rni: 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.

points.en: We use never in statements.  —  I've never visited America. (= I haven't visited America.)
points.uz: NEVER ni darak gaplarda ishlatamiz. — Amerikaga hech qachon bormaganman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'never' O'ZI INKOR:
'I haven't never visited' — XATO!
Ikki xil aytish mumkin: 'I've NEVER visited'
yoki 'I HAVEN'T visited'.

points.en: We use just in statements to show that an action finished only a few minutes earlier.  —  A: Have you finished your homework?  B: Yes, I've just finished it.
points.uz: JUST ni harakat bir necha daqiqa oldin tugaganini ko'rsatish uchun darak gaplarda ishlatamiz. — A: Uy vazifangni tugatdingmi? B: Ha, hozirgina tugatdim.

exercises.explanationUz:
YET / ALREADY — KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use ALREADY in STATEMENTS and
    QUESTIONS.'
      Have you done the washing up ALREADY?
      Yes, I have. I've ALREADY done it.

 • 'We use YET in QUESTIONS and NEGATIVES.'
      Have you done the ironing YET?
      No, I haven't. I haven't done the
      ironing YET.


⚠ DIQQAT — 'ALREADY' SAVOLDA HAM BO'LADI:
  Coursebook 106-betda faqat 'tasdiqda'
  deyilgan edi, Grammar Book esa
  'statements AND QUESTIONS' deydi.

  Farqi MA'NODA:
     'Have you done it YET?'
        = oddiy savol (qildingmi?)
     'Have you done it ALREADY?'
        = AJABLANISH (allaqachonmi?
          shunchalik tezmi?)


O'RNI:
  ALREADY — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA
     'I've ALREADY done it.'
     (savolda esa gap oxirida ham bo'ladi:
      'Have you done it ALREADY?')

  YET — DOIM GAP OXIRIDA
     'Have you done the ironing YET?'
     'I haven't done the ironing YET.'


UY IShLARI LUG'ATI (kitob misollaridan):
  'the washing up' = idish yuvish
  'the ironing'    = dazmollash
  'the washing'    = kir yuvish
  'the shopping'   = xarid

  Hammasi 'DO' fe'li bilan:
     do the washing up / the ironing /
     the shopping


─────────────────────────────────────

FOR / SINCE — KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use FOR to express DURATION.'
      I've worked here FOR seven years.

 • 'We use SINCE to state a STARTING POINT.'
      I've worked here SINCE 1992.


ENG ODDIY FARQ:
  FOR   + QANChA VAQT
          for seven years, for three days,
          for a long time
  SINCE + QAChONDAN BERI
          since 1992, since Monday,
          since last week

  Savol bering: 'qancha vaqt?' → FOR
                'qachondan beri?' → SINCE


DIQQAT — IKKALA MISOL HAM BIR XIL GAP:
  'I've worked here FOR seven years.'
  'I've worked here SINCE 1992.'

  Agar hozir 1999-yil bo'lsa, ikkalasi ham
  bir xil ma'no beradi — faqat boshqacha
  aytilgan!

points.en: We use already in statements and questions.  —  Have you done the washing up already? Yes, I have. I've already done it.
points.uz: ALREADY ni darak va so'roq gaplarda ishlatamiz. — Idishlarni allaqachon yuvdingmi? Ha. Allaqachon yuvdim.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Grammar Book 'savolda ham' deydi.
Savolda 'already' — AJABLANISH ma'nosi
(shunchalik tezmi?).

points.en: We use yet in questions and negatives.  —  Have you done the ironing yet? No, I haven't. I haven't done the ironing yet.
points.uz: YET ni so'roq va inkor gaplarda ishlatamiz. — Dazmollab bo'ldingmi? Yo'q, hali dazmollamadim.

points.en: We use for to express duration.  —  I've worked here for seven years.
points.uz: FOR ni davomiylikni bildirish uchun ishlatamiz. — Bu yerda yetti yildan beri ishlayman.

points.en: We use since to state a starting point.  —  I've worked here since 1992.
points.uz: SINCE ni boshlanish nuqtasini aytish uchun ishlatamiz. — Bu yerda 1992-yildan beri ishlayman.
points.noteUz:
SINCE + QACHONDAN BERI.

DIQQAT: ikkala misol AYNI BIR gapni ikki xil
aytish (agar hozir 1999 bo'lsa).

exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ BU BETDAGI ENG MUHIM QOIDA

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:
  'There are TWO WAYS to form the present
   perfect of the verb GO: HAVE GONE and
   HAVE BEEN, but there is a DIFFERENCE IN
   MEANING.'

  MISOLLAR:

  'Bob and Marie HAVE GONE to Rome.'
     (They went to Rome some time ago and
      they are STILL THERE.)

  'I HAVE BEEN to Rome.'
     (I have visited Rome and COME BACK.
      I am NOT there now.)


ENG ODDIY FARQ:

  HAVE GONE TO  →  KETGAN va HALI U YERDA
     'He has gone to Rome.'
     = U Rimga ketgan (hozir Rimda)

  HAVE BEEN TO  →  BORIB QAYTGAN
     'He has been to Rome.'
     = U Rimda bo'lgan (hozir bu yerda)


QANDAY ESLAB QOLISh:

  GONE — odam YO'Q (ketgan)
  BEEN — odam BOR (qaytgan)

  Yoki:
     'gone' = ketish (harakati)
     'been' = bo'lish (tajribasi)


ShUNING UChUN:

  'I HAVE GONE to Rome.'  — deyarli
     ISHLATILMAYDI! (chunki agar Rimda
     bo'lsangiz, bu gapni aytolmaysiz)

  'I HAVE BEEN to Rome.'  ✓
     (tajriba haqida)

  Ya'ni O'ZINGIZ haqingizda deyarli doim
  'BEEN' ishlatasiz.


MISOLLAR YONMA-YON:

  'Where's Tom?' — 'He HAS GONE to the shops.'
     (do'konda, hali qaytmagan)

  'Have you ever been to Paris?' —
  'Yes, I HAVE BEEN there twice.'
     (borgan va qaytgan)

  'My parents HAVE GONE to Turkey.'
     (hozir Turkiyada)

  'My parents HAVE BEEN to Turkey.'
     (borishgan va qaytishgan)


BOG'LIQLIK — COURSEBOOK:
  104-bet, 1-mashq:
     'Have you ever BEEN there?'
  106-bet, 11-mashq:
     'I've BEEN to Spain.'
     'I've never BEEN to China.'
  107-bet, 16-mashq:
     'Have you BEEN to Palacio Real yet?'
     (Pol borib qaytgan, shuning uchun 'been')

  Coursebook'da deyarli doim 'been'
  ishlatilgan — endi nega ekani ma'lum.


DIQQAT — PREDLOG:
  'have been TO Rome'   ✓ (borgan)
  'have been IN Rome'   — boshqa ma'no
     ('Rimda bo'lganman' — ichkarida,
      masalan 'I've been in Rome for a week')

  'have gone TO Rome'   ✓


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a difference in meaning = ma'no farqi
  still     = hali ham
  to come back = qaytmoq
exercises.bookRef: Grammar Book, 65-bet, 'Have gone (to) - Have been (to)' qutisi

points.en: There are two ways to form the present perfect of the verb go: have gone and have been, but there is a difference in meaning.
points.uz: 'go' fe'lining Present Perfect shakli ikki xil bo'ladi: have gone va have been, lekin ma'nosi FARQ QILADI.

points.en: Bob and Marie have gone to Rome. (They went to Rome some time ago and they are still there.)
points.uz: Bob va Mari Rimga ketishgan. (Bir muddat oldin ketishgan va HALI HAM u yerda.)
points.noteUz:
HAVE GONE TO → ketgan va HALI U YERDA.
Odam YO'Q.

points.en: I have been to Rome. (I have visited Rome and come back. I am not there now.)
points.uz: Men Rimda bo'lganman. (Rimga borganman va qaytganman. Hozir u yerda emasman.)
points.noteUz:
HAVE BEEN TO → borib QAYTGAN.
Odam BOR.

O'zingiz haqingizda deyarli doim 'BEEN'
ishlatasiz.

points.en: Where's Tom? — He has gone to the shops.  /  Have you ever been to Paris? — Yes, I have been there twice.
points.uz: Tom qayerda? — Do'konga ketgan. / Parijda bo'lganmisiz? — Ha, ikki marta bo'lganman.

exercises.instructionEn: Expand the prompts into sentences using for or since, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalarni for yoki since bilan to'liq gaplarga aylantiring, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  She has lived in Brazil SINCE 1992.
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)
 2  He has been ill FOR three days.
 3  They haven't visited their grandparents
    SINCE last month.
 4  I have been a policeman FOR twenty years.
 5  Karen hasn't been home SINCE October.
 6  He hasn't travelled by boat SINCE last
    summer.
 7  I haven't been to Paris FOR six years.
 8  Jack has worked in Canada FOR ten years.
 9  She hasn't been abroad FOR two years.
10  Jeff hasn't called SINCE Monday.


FOR yoki SINCE — TAQSIMOT:

  FOR (davomiylik) — 2, 4, 7, 8, 9:
     three days, twenty years, six years,
     ten years, two years

  SINCE (nuqta) — 1, 3, 5, 6, 10:
     1992, last month, October,
     last summer, Monday

  Ya'ni beshtadan teng!


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — OXIRGI QISMGA QARANG:

  RAQAM + vaqt birligi  →  FOR
     'three days', 'twenty years'

  YIL, OY, KUN, 'last ...'  →  SINCE
     '1992', 'October', 'Monday',
     'last month', 'last summer'


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
 1  U 1992-yildan beri Braziliyada yashaydi.
 2  U uch kundan beri kasal.
 3  Ular o'tgan oydan beri buvilarinikiga
    bormagan.
 4  Men yigirma yildan beri militsionerman.
 5  Karen oktyabrdan beri uyda bo'lmagan.
 6  U o'tgan yozdan beri qayiqda sayohat
    qilmagan.
 7  Olti yildan beri Parijga bormaganman.
 8  Jek o'n yildan beri Kanadada ishlaydi.
 9  U ikki yildan beri chet elga chiqmagan.
10  Jeff dushanbadan beri qo'ng'iroq qilmagan.


HAR BIRIDA NIMA QO'ShILADI:

  1) HAVE / HAS
     ega III shaxs birlik → HAS
     (1, 2, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10-bandlar)
     qolganlarida → HAVE
     (3, 4, 7-bandlar)

  2) FE'LNING III ShAKLI (V3):
     live   → LIVED
     be     → BEEN
     visit  → VISITED
     travel → TRAVELLED
     go     → BEEN (quyiga qarang!)
     work   → WORKED
     call   → CALLED

  3) 'NOT' bo'lsa → HAVEN'T / HASN'T
     (3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10-bandlar)

  4) FOR yoki SINCE


⚠ 7-BAND HAQIDA MUHIM IZOH:

  'I/not go/to Paris/six years'

  Javob: 'I HAVEN'T BEEN to Paris for six
         years.'

  NEGA 'BEEN', 'GONE' EMAS?
  Bu betdagi grammatika qutisi tushuntiradi:
     'have GONE to' = ketgan va HALI U YERDA
     'have BEEN to' = borib QAYTGAN

  'I haven't GONE to Paris' — g'alati
  (o'zim haqimda 'gone' ishlatilmaydi).
  'I haven't BEEN to Paris' ✓

  Kitob ataylab shu bandni qo'ygan — yangi
  qoidani sinash uchun.


DIQQAT — 5 va 9-BANDLARDAGI 'BE':
  5  'Karen hasn't BEEN home since October.'
  9  'She hasn't BEEN abroad for two years.'

  Bu yerda 'be' — 'bo'lmoq' ma'nosida
  (harakat emas).

  'be HOME' — predlog YO'Q
     ('be at home' ham to'g'ri)
  'be ABROAD' — predlog YO'Q
     ('go abroad' = chet elga chiqmoq)


DIQQAT — 2 va 4-BANDLARDAGI 'BE':
  2  'He has BEEN ill for three days.'
     = uch kundan beri kasal (HOZIR HAM)
  4  'I have BEEN a policeman for twenty
     years.'
     = yigirma yildan beri militsionerman
       (HOZIR HAM)

  Bu — 64-betdagi IKKINCHI qo'llanish:
  o'tmishda boshlanib, HOZIR HAM davom
  etayotgan holat.

  O'zbekchada HOZIRGI zamon bilan tarjima
  qilinadi!


DIQQAT — 'TRAVELLED' (6-band):
  Britancha: travelLED (IKKI 'L')
  Amerikacha: traveLED


DIQQAT — 'BY BOAT' (6-band):
  'travel BY boat / BY plane / BY car'
  Transport 'BY' bilan, ARTIKLSIZ.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  ill          = kasal
  grandparents = bobo-buvi
  a policeman  = militsioner
  abroad       = chet elda
  to call      = qo'ng'iroq qilmoq
  by boat      = qayiqda

items.sentence: 1  She/live in Brazil/1992  →  She has lived in Brazil ............ 1992.

commonMistake.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
'1992' — YIL, ya'ni ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE.

live → LIVED (to'g'ri fe'l).
ega 'She' → HAS.

items.sentence: 2  He/be/ill/three days  →  He has been ill ............ three days.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'three days' — RAQAM + VAQT BIRLIGI
→ DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

be → BEEN (V3).

⚠ Bu — 64-betdagi IKKINCHI qo'llanish:
o'tmishda boshlanib HOZIR HAM davom etayotgan
holat. O'zbekchada HOZIRGI zamon bilan
tarjima qilinadi ('kasal').

items.sentence: 3  They/not visit/their grandparents/last month  →  They haven't visited their grandparents ............ last month.
items.uz: Ular o'tgan oydan beri buvilarinikiga bormagan.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'last month' — ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE.

DIQQAT — CHALG'ITUVCHI:
  'FOR a month'      (davomiylik)
  'SINCE last month' (nuqta)
'last' so'zi ANIQ NUQTANI bildiradi.

'not' bor → HAVEN'T (ega 'They').
visit → VISITED.

items.sentence: 4  I/be/a policeman/twenty years  →  I have been a policeman ............ twenty years.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'twenty years' — DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

be → BEEN.
ega 'I' → HAVE.

Yana IKKINCHI qo'llanish: hozir ham
militsioner ('militsionerman').

items.sentence: 5  Karen/not be/home/October  →  Karen hasn't been home ............ October.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'October' — OY nomi, ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE.

'not' bor + ega 'Karen' (III shaxs birlik)
→ HASN'T.

DIQQAT: 'be HOME' — predlog YO'Q
('be AT home' ham to'g'ri).

items.sentence: 6  He/not travel/by boat/last summer  →  He hasn't travelled by boat ............ last summer.
items.uz: U o'tgan yozdan beri qayiqda sayohat qilmagan.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'last summer' — ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE
('last' so'zi kalit).

travel → TRAVELLED (britancha, IKKI 'L').
'BY boat' — transport 'by' bilan, ARTIKLSIZ.

'not' + 'He' → HASN'T.

items.sentence: 7  I/not go/to Paris/six years  →  I haven't been to Paris ............ six years.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'six years' — DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

⚠ ENG MUHIM IZOH — 'BEEN', 'GONE' EMAS:
Bu betdagi grammatika qutisi:
  'have GONE to' = ketgan va HALI U YERDA
  'have BEEN to' = borib QAYTGAN

'I haven't GONE to Paris' — g'alati
(o'zim haqimda 'gone' ishlatilmaydi).
'I haven't BEEN to Paris' ✓

Kitob ataylab shu bandni qo'ygan — yangi
qoidani sinash uchun.

items.sentence: 8  Jack/work in Canada/ten years  →  Jack has worked in Canada ............ ten years.
items.uz: Jek o'n yildan beri Kanadada ishlaydi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'ten years' — DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

work → WORKED (to'g'ri fe'l).
ega 'Jack' → HAS.

IKKINCHI qo'llanish: hozir ham ishlaydi.

items.sentence: 9  She/not be abroad/two years  →  She hasn't been abroad ............ two years.
items.uz: U ikki yildan beri chet elga chiqmagan.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'two years' — DAVOMIYLIK → FOR.

'not' + 'She' → HASN'T.
be → BEEN.

'ABROAD' — predlog YO'Q:
  'go abroad'  ✓
  'go to abroad' ✗

items.sentence: 10  Jeff/not call/Monday  →  Jeff hasn't called ............ Monday.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'Monday' — HAFTA KUNI, ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE.

'not' + 'Jeff' → HASN'T.
call → CALLED (to'g'ri fe'l).

'to call' = qo'ng'iroq qilmoq
(= 'to phone', 'to ring').

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table below and make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi jadvalga qarang va namunadagidek gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL — UCh EGA, TO'RT ISh:

            go to  eat     travel  take a
            the    Mexican to      boat
            opera  food    Europe  trip
  ────────  ─────  ──────  ──────  ──────
  Tom         ✗      ✓       ✓       ✗
  Andrea      ✓      ✗       ✗       ✓
  The Smiths  ✓      ✗       ✓       ✗


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA (Tom):

  'Tom HASN'T BEEN to the opera, BUT he HAS
   EATEN Mexican food. He HAS ALSO TRAVELLED
   to Europe, BUT he HASN'T TAKEN a boat trip.'


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 ANDREA:
  'Andrea HAS BEEN to the opera, BUT she
   HASN'T EATEN Mexican food. She HASN'T
   TRAVELLED to Europe, BUT she HAS TAKEN a
   boat trip.'

  Tarjimasi: Andrea operaga borgan, lekin
  meksika taomini yeb ko'rmagan. U Yevropaga
  sayohat qilmagan, lekin qayiqda sayohat
  qilgan.


 THE SMITHS:
  'The Smiths HAVE BEEN to the opera, BUT they
   HAVEN'T EATEN Mexican food. They HAVE
   TRAVELLED to Europe, BUT they HAVEN'T TAKEN
   a boat trip.'

  Tarjimasi: Smitlar operaga borishgan, lekin
  meksika taomini yeb ko'rishmagan. Ular
  Yevropaga sayohat qilishgan, lekin qayiqda
  sayohat qilishmagan.


⚠ UCh MUHIM NUQTA:

 1) 'GO TO THE OPERA' → 'HAVE BEEN TO':
    Namuna 'Tom hasn't BEEN to the opera'
    deydi, 'hasn't GONE' emas!

    Chunki bu betdagi qoida:
       'have BEEN to' = borib qaytgan
                        (TAJRIBA)
       'have GONE to' = hali u yerda

    Jadvalda TAJRIBA haqida so'ralyapti,
    shuning uchun DOIM 'been'.

 2) 'THE SMITHS' — KO'PLIK:
    'The Smiths HAVE been ...'  ✓
    'The Smiths HAS been ...'   ✗

    'the Smiths' = Smitlar (butun oila),
    shuning uchun KO'PLIK va olmoshi 'THEY'.

    (Workbook 53-betda ham shu haqda edi:
     'the SmithS' house' — apostrof o'rni.)

 3) 'BUT' NING O'RNI:
    Namuna har ikki ishni 'BUT' bilan
    bog'laydi:
       [1-ish], BUT [2-ish].
       [3-ish], BUT [4-ish].

    Chunki har juftlikda biri ✓, biri ✗.


V3 ShAKLLARI (jadvaldagi fe'llar):
  go     →  went     →  BEEN / GONE
  eat    →  ate      →  EATEN
  travel →  travelled →  TRAVELLED
  take   →  took     →  TAKEN

  DIQQAT: 'eaten', 'taken' — '-EN' bilan.


OLMOShLAR:
  Tom        →  HE   →  has
  Andrea     →  SHE  →  has
  The Smiths →  THEY →  have


DIQQAT — 'ALSO' NING O'RNI:
  Namunada: 'He HAS ALSO TRAVELLED to Europe'
  'also' — 'has' va V3 ORASIDA.

  Xuddi 'already', 'just', 'never' kabi.

  Andrea uchun 'also' kerak emas, chunki
  uning uchinchi ishi ✗ (inkor).


DIQQAT — 'MEXICAN FOOD':
  Millat sifatlari BOSH HARF bilan:
     Mexican food, Chinese food,
     Italian food, Turkish coffee


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the opera    = opera
  Mexican food = meksika taomi
  Europe       = Yevropa
  to take a boat trip = qayiqda sayohat qilmoq
  the Smiths   = Smitlar (oila)

points.en: Tom hasn't been to the opera, but he has eaten Mexican food. He has also travelled to Europe, but he hasn't taken a boat trip.
points.uz: Tom operaga bormagan, lekin meksika taomini yeb ko'rgan. Yevropaga ham sayohat qilgan, lekin qayiqda sayohat qilmagan.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.

⚠ 'hasn't BEEN to the opera' — 'gone' EMAS!
Jadvalda TAJRIBA haqida so'ralyapti.

'ALSO' — 'has' va V3 ORASIDA.

points.en: Andrea has been to the opera, but she hasn't eaten Mexican food. She hasn't travelled to Europe, but she has taken a boat trip.
points.uz: Andrea operaga borgan, lekin meksika taomini yeb ko'rmagan. U Yevropaga sayohat qilmagan, lekin qayiqda sayohat qilgan.
points.noteUz:
Jadval: ✓ ✗ ✗ ✓

'Andrea' → SHE → HAS.
eat → EATEN;  take → TAKEN.

DIQQAT: bu yerda 'also' kerak emas, chunki
uchinchi ish INKOR.

points.en: The Smiths have been to the opera, but they haven't eaten Mexican food. They have travelled to Europe, but they haven't taken a boat trip.
points.uz: Smitlar operaga borishgan, lekin meksika taomini yeb ko'rishmagan. Ular Yevropaga sayohat qilishgan, lekin qayiqda sayohat qilishmagan.
points.noteUz:
Jadval: ✓ ✗ ✓ ✗

⚠ 'The Smiths' — KO'PLIK!
'The Smiths HAVE been' ✓
'The Smiths HAS been' ✗
Olmoshi: THEY.

patterns.exampleEn: She has lived in Brazil since 1992. He has been ill for three days.

FOR + raqam va vaqt birligi;
SINCE + yil, oy, kun, 'last ...'.

patterns.exampleEn: Bob and Marie have gone to Rome. Where's Tom? — He has gone to the shops.

O'zingiz haqingizda deyarli doim 'been'.
